cases.description: REGRESSION: an item that already carries a correct bucket_file_id (the cache-miss path, inherited from the child workflow's own Attach Bucket File ID after crossing the Execute Workflow: File Extraction Item boundary) -> preserved as-is, NOT overwritten by itemMatching -- even though itemMatching would resolve to a DIFFERENT value here, simulating exactly the unreliable cross-boundary lookup that silently mis-tagged every item in the real production bug this node was written to fix

an item genuinely missing bucket_file_id (the cache-hit path, Check Cache's raw response -- no Execute Workflow boundary crossed on this path, so itemMatching is safe here) -> derived via itemMatching against this workflow's own trigger
mixed batch: one item already correctly tagged (cache miss), one missing it (cache hit) -> each resolved independently and correctly, not conflated
